newsitem.title: FRANCE: French capital markets closing report.
newsitem.headline: French capital markets closing report.

text.p: French bond futures finished the MATIF trading session just inside positive territory on the eve of a Federal Reserve meeting where an increase in U.S. interest rates is being predicted by the bulk of market experts.

The June 10-year future started up but ebbed with its German counterpart after Bundesbank council member Ernst Welteke said he would like to see stable U.S. rates for as long as possible and that rising rates there could mean rising rates in Germany.
A late pick-up in Germany helped the French futures contract out of the red to end at 127.86 and traders said it was likely to hover around 127.80 on Tuesday ahead of the U.S. outcome.
